snippet.title: [PS3] Idolm@sters SHINY TV - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Sample gameplay for IM@S Shiny TV which is freely downloadable in Japanese PSN but you have to buy the Volumes as DLC which contains 6 songs per volume. Cost 1500 yen per volume.

The game is packed on single dashboard which they called "Idolm@ster Channel" that holds the two separate titles which is "SHINY TV" and "Gravure for You" that I may be showcase to you later on.
